I have anorexia (diagnosed by real doctors not tumblr) and when I was 15 it got way out of control. I was 81lbs at 5'5", and I was pulled out of school and placed in a local hospitals eating disorder ward for 6 months. I did NOT want to be there, my feelings of dread were amplified by what I saw on my first day... the staff. There was only one thin staff member, a male councillor, the rest of the staff were fat women ranging from skinny fat all the way to death fat. She stood at around 5'5" and weighed at least 370lbs, but was probably closer to 400lbs, she walked with bowed legs from her fat, and was always seen sweating as she walked to and from her office. She was in charge of making to meal plans for each patient, increasing our intake, and teaching us about "healthy eating". How they let someone who was so clearly out of control with her own eating habits work with eating disordered girls truly baffles me.

I hated her more than I hated anyone, and I was also pretty unstable at this time. I had gained up to around 95lbs when she called me into her office for our weekly chat. Cathy's eyes opened wide with terror, her face turned red and blotchy, she started to sweat more than a runner finishing a marathon in 30 degree heat. I placed the scissors delicately on her desk and walked out of her office.

I honestly think if whoever was increasing me wasn't 400lbs of pure butter, I wouldn't have snapped like that. They shouldn't have fat staff in eating disorder wards. It makes recovery harder, and brings out the crazy in some patients.
